scope: Exploratory primary-pool comparison of specified classifier/abstention pipelines.
target_source: Genus-aware Kraken2 coverage on primary test pool; test-informed target, validation-fitted temperature and cutoff.
policy_selection: Native MetaTransformer was selected for the main comparison after inspection of the v7 results. Earlier TS-MT comparison remains a diagnostic.
selection: Intersection of accepted reads (remove union of declines).
detection: Redraw 200 sparse communities of 1000 reads with 60 of 120 genera selected, from retained pool. 98 partition communities for abundance.
bootstrap_scope: Paired reads for accuracy, paired communities for detection. Fixed checkpoints; no training-variance inference.
